Good value food and drinks in Phu Quoc on main street
Jul 2026 • Friends
A quiet weekday evening, not many customers which was good. Three or four draft beers on tap including a local lager, good value. 

Decent menu of salads, burgers, pasta, Vietnamese food - had three drinks and two dishes and came to 350,000 which was great value. Don’t under the previous review about spending too much. No extra charges. Nice people good service, appears family run, range of music on the playlist. 

Just what I was looking for - recommend it. Also pool, board games. Probably much more lively at weekend and in tourist season.
